title: Signs that the need for change is an instinct

statements.text: The need for change looks instinctive. It appears without training, as small children break things the way kittens hunt. It returns periodically, felt as boredom. Unmet, it brings depression, as in people with boring, repetitive work. And a room with nothing to change is among the worst punishments.

sources.quote: Instinctive needs have to be fulfilled periodically
Humans are more likely to fall into depression if they have boring / repetitive work.
